feed.title: Meta accused in class action of profiting from scam cryptocurrency ads

The lawsuit seeks to represent a nationwide class of users who suffered losses from crypto scams promoted through these ads, suing for violations of California consumer laws and breach of contract.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley delivers blunt message to America’s pet owners

Morgan Stanley suggests the upcoming redesign of the Chewy+ membership program and growth in its healthcare business could be catalysts for a future re-rating of the stock.

This divergence occurred after UBS downgraded NuScale Power, questioning its commercialization timeline and financial projections. The market's reaction highlighted a preference for companies with existing operational power assets and current earnings over those with speculative future projects in the advanced nuclear sector.
